task.title: My hobbies
task.description: Make a "My hobbies" page: a favicon in head, one h1, at least three img (src, alt, width), one of them in a figure with figcaption, one decorative with alt="", a video with controls and source. No autoplay.
task.starter_code:
My hobbies

Tell about yourself.
hints: Do not use autoplay or empty descriptions like alt="picture".

questions.question: Which attribute gives the path to the file?
questions.explanation: src means source, the image source.

questions.question: What alt does a decorative divider pattern that says nothing need?
questions.explanation: An empty alt="" makes the screen reader skip the image. Without alt it may read the file name.

questions.question: Which format suits a simple logo that must stay sharp at any size?
questions.explanation: SVG is vector and does not lose quality when enlarged.

questions.question: What happens if <video> has no controls attribute?
questions.explanation: controls shows the play, volume and seek buttons.

questions.question: What is the alt attribute for?
options: It is shown if the image fails to load
It helps search engines understand the image
questions.explanation: alt is the text replacement of an image.

questions.question: Which formats suit photos?
questions.explanation: Photos are JPEG or WebP. SVG is for vector graphics.

questions.question: What is true about width and height on ?
options: The browser reserves space in advance
A wrong ratio distorts the image
Without them the image is not shown
questions.explanation: Sizes stop the text from "jumping"; with one side the ratio is kept.

questions.question: Match the attribute with its purpose.
questions.explanation: Media attributes control loading and playback.

questions.question: Match the tag with its role.
pairs: A file inside audio or video
An embedded external page, e.g. a YouTube video
questions.explanation: figure groups an image with its caption, source sets the media file.

questions.question: Which attribute of the link tag connects the site icon? Enter the whole notation, e.g. rel="...".
Which tag embeds a YouTube video? Enter the tag name without brackets.
questions.explanation: iframe is a window into another page. Do not forget title.

questions.question: What is the empty element for inserting an image called? Enter the tag name without brackets.
questions.explanation: img is an empty element with no closing tag.
